tipps: Vom Dorfzentrum Fließ aus führt ein malerischer Spazierweg mit schönem Fotoblick an der Burg vorbei.
kurzbeschreibung: Burg Biedenegg is perched on a sunny hillside terrace in Fließ above the Oberinntal and once guarded the historic Roman road over the Pillerpass.
beschreibung:
Fortified Guardian over the Inntal

Situated on a scenic hillside terrace in the municipality of Fließ lies Burg Biedenegg (also known as Bideneck). Built in the early 14th century, the hilltop castle secured the vital trade route of the Via Claudia Augusta and the pass across the Gache Blick toward Pillerhöhe.

Late Medieval Defensive Architecture

The mighty, quadrangular keep with its characteristic swallowtail merlons and fortified walls continues to shape the cultural landscape of the upper judicial district of Landeck. The historic castle complex is privately owned and provides an impressive photographic motif.
